chunks: Safwan ibn Yahya asked Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام:
About a man who made his employee witness a testimony, then parted from him: is his testimony valid after he parts from him? He said: "Yes."
I said: Then if a Jew was made witness to a testimony and then embraced Islam, is his testimony valid? He said: "Yes."

key_terms.شَهَادَةٍ: formal legal testimony or witness statement
key_terms.فَارَقَهُ: he parted from him or separated from him

ai.seo_question: Is testimony still valid if the witness was formerly an employee or a non-Muslim who later became Muslim?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on testimony based on testimony. It indicates that a person's prior status as an employee, or a Jew who later accepts Islam, does not invalidate testimony after the relevant change in status.
